review_basis.method: Independently compared learner-facing content with each active concept's blocked_future_concepts, prerequisites and teaching facts. Required understanding, rather than keyword presence, determines leakage. Generator reasoning and prior evaluator findings were not consulted; deterministic gates were not rerun.

coverage.text_review: Exhaustive across screen titles, ledes, prose, recap and remediation text, diagram labels and alt text, code walkthroughs and annotations, and up-next titles. Also reviewed assembled media summaries and before/after bridges.
coverage.sampling_method: Stratified across all five concepts, including choice and code-exercise interactions; reviewed sampled prompts, options, workspaces, constraints, feedback and hints.

findings_by_tile.finding: Zip content requires corresponding tuple pairing, two-variable loops and shortest-input stopping, not iterator consumption, lazy processing, diagnostic-print placement or starred unpacking. Printing loop results is ordinary output, not the later diagnostic-printing concept. The shared-reference up-next title is only a preview.

Shared-reference material stays with assignment, shallow copies and outer versus nested mutations. Counter material stays with imports, element counts, returned lists, guarded access and first-encounter ties. Neither sampled interaction requires later sorting keys, class implementation, exception handling or iterator machinery. The diagnostic-printing up-next title is only a preview.

Diagnostic content uses labeled observations, repr and placement/removal. Docstring content uses first-statement strings, accurate interface details and help(cost), all directly taught. Mentions of modules, classes, methods and applicable exceptions do not require understanding their later implementation or exception hierarchy. The sampled hint about inspecting the function object supports the explicitly taught help(function) call; it does not require functions-as-values programming. The supplied if True wrapper requires only an ordinary conditional, not closure or enclosing-scope knowledge. The exception-hierarchy up-next title is only a preview.

limitations: Interaction review is sampled as required by stage 09; this is not a final audit or an exhaustive interaction correctness review. No web/video access was used; available segment summaries and bridges were reviewed.
